messages:
Marisol G.: Quick thread for onsite candidate (Priya Sharma) next Tue. Interview block 09:30-1:00. She9s arriving on overnight train and may have luggage. Need: badge + secure luggage storage, laptop (macOS fine), quiet room for take-home exercise at 10:00, vegetarian halal lunch, and 9am early lobby access. Tagging ops.
IT Support: We can reserve a loaner MacBook, image with macOS Monterey, VS Code, and test harness. Will label device 'cand-1976' and leave in room C2 by 08:50. Any Docker needed?
Marisol G.: No Docker. Just CLI + Node. Thanks.
Facilities: We have luggage locker L3 available; we'll leave a key at reception. Quiet room C2 reserved 09:45-12:15. Early lobby access OK; security escort at 08:55.
Finance: Travel stipend policy: can reimburse up to $80 for regional train. Ask candidate to submit receipt in Expensify with 'candidate-travel' tag.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: candidate meal cap $40. Upload receipts with 'candidate-meal' tag for auto-routing.
Marisol G.: Catering: please order vegetarian halal boxed lunches; include gluten-free option.
Facilities: Catering ordered, labelled GF where needed. Delivery 11:30 to C2.
IT Support: Teams link for hiring manager added; remote interviewer Sam will join at 12:00 PDT. AV test at 11:40.
Marisol G.: Who will meet Priya at lobby? I can do it but traveling from transit hub might be tight. If I9m late, please badge her through.
Facilities: Reception can badge her and hold luggage key. We'll notify security if Marisol is running late.
Marisol G.: Great — I'll DM my mobile on the invite and confirm final ETA. Thanks all.
